Nvidia stops selling H200 chips in China

• Nvidia will stop selling its H200 AI accelerator chips in China after board concerns over CEO Jensen Huang's conduct.
• Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, completed an IPO on the Nasdaq last Thursday, becoming one of the most valuable companies on the planet.
• Google Duplex, first launched in 2018, is now part of Gemini Tasks, enabling AI-driven phone calls for everyday chores.

items.text:
Nvidia stops H200 sales China, investors worry.

• Nvidia announced it will no longer sell H200 AI chips to customers in China.
• The chips were previously accessed via data centres in nearby countries, bypassing export bans.
• Analysts say about 20% of Nvidia’s business ties to China, though not in direct sales.

Our read: If you depend on AI hardware, track Nvidia’s policy changes.
